source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 17738; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer. It has NOT been re-read by a second agent, so raw_html_verified stays false and extraction_status stays extracted_draft. Nothing in this record is a rule, a reading of the text for any lot, a derived or computed number, or an eligibility determination; it is the official source text of one ZR section only. Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).

cross_check.pdf_regeneration_note: The print/PDF is regenerated per request (it carries a 'File generated ... on' banner), so raw_pdf_sha256 pins the exact render cross-checked at retrieved_at; a re-fetch would differ in bytes though not in printed text (DB-167).
cross_check.method: The section's print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/17738 -> print/pdf/node/17738) was retrieved (HTTP 200, application/pdf, raw_pdf_sha256 pinned) and its text layer read with pdftotext -layout. Each block of the HTML-derived verbatim_excerpt was confirmed to appear in the PDF text layer (compared lowercase, straight-quote, whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive; the stored excerpt keeps the HTML's unbroken section-number form where pdftotext wraps a hyphen). The list-item labels in the excerpt are the labels this print/PDF prints in front of each item, confirmed item-by-item. The print/PDF node renders this parent section AND its child sections; every block of this parent-body excerpt was confirmed present within that render, ending before the first child header (33-261).

verbatim_excerpt:
C1 C2 C3 C4 C5 C6 C7 C8

In all districts, other than C7 Districts, a #rear yard# with a depth of not less than 20 feet shall be provided at every #rear lot line# on any #zoning lot# except as otherwise provided in Sections 33-27 (Special Provisions for Shallow Interior Lots), 33-28 (Special Provisions for Through Lots) or 33-30 (OTHER SPECIAL PROVISIONS FOR REAR YARDS). #Rear yards# shall also be provided along portions of #side lot lines# as set forth in Section 33-261 (Beyond one hundred feet of a street line).

For C7 Districts, the provisions of Section 33-262 shall apply. However, such provisions shall be modified by the provisions of 33-27, 33-28 or 33-30.
verbatim_excerpt_composition:
Verbatim blocks of the section body (the sec-body field--name-body container), joined by blank lines, in page order. Each paragraph and each list item is one block; a double

splits a heading line from its paragraph. A list item carries a parenthesised outline label taken from the official PRINT/PDF (the HTML
    markup can restart a list; the labels here were confirmed item-by-item against the print, M3-T008 G1 F1). Defined terms (bold-italic ) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF writes them, inner spacing preserved. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures are omitted; inline section-reference links are kept as their text; no word was changed. The section number and title are recorded in section_number/section_title and are not repeated in the excerpt.
